thread:
sara_sales: FYI — Acme Finance wants us to onboard 'equinox-XL' (open model) in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1, pinned to v1.2 quantized int8. They need low-latency fraud scoring and want dedicated capacity + SSO + EU data residency. Can we triage?

matt_product: Thanks Sara. Need a few details before we push to backlog: expected peak QPS, target latency SLO (p95), whether they require Dedicated capacity with SLA, and confirm model license and checksum. Is v1.2 already in our catalog?

sara_sales: They expect ~150 QPS peak, p95 < 120ms, batch size 1. They explicitly asked for quantized int8 variant and want a dedicated pool per region under enterprise contract. I'll ask legal about license checksum but they said model is from an MIT-like repo and pointed to a tarball.

jin_engineering: Quick engineering take: equinox-XL has long context and heavy KV cache pressure. int8 quantization should be feasible, but memory per replica remains sizable on A100-80/32. To hit 150 QPS at p95 120ms we likely need ~4 GPUs in eu-west-1 with our current runtime tuning (assumes KV caching enabled). APAC will be similar. For a pilot we should start at 20–25 QPS to validate quality and perf. Also need model artifact + tokenization config and v1.2 checksum.

ana_devex: We need a sample integration and a quickstart doc for pinned models + routing fallback. I'll prepare a repo example and a config snippet for pinned+fallback routing, e.g.:

```yaml
model: equinox-xl:v1.2-int8
route_policy:
  primary: eu-west-1
  fallback: eu-central-1
  capacity: dedicated
```

I'll also add an eval harness to monitor hallucination/regression after quantization.

leo_security: Data residency + SSO notes: If they require VPC/private deployment for logs and inference data we need a legal review for log retention & audit. Also confirm whether any model artifacts have export-control flags; if so, APAC placement may be restricted.

triage-bot: Ticket created INF-4321: "Equinox-XL enterprise onboard — EU/APAC pinned quantized variant". Priority: P2. Owner: @matt_product. Required artifacts: model tarball + checksum, tokenizers, eval prompts, signed enterprise commitment for Dedicated capacity.

matt_product: Decision for now: move to Engineering intake. Action items: (1) Sales to get model artifact + checksum and commit for Dedicated capacity; (2) Engineering to scope pilot in eu-west-1; (3) DevEx to prepare sample app + eval harness. Target pilot: eu-west-1 in 6 weeks, pilot QPS 25, go-live scale after perf validation. @jin_engineering any showstoppers?

jin_engineering: No showstoppers for pilot — we can spin up a small dedicated pool and enable KV caching + batching tuning. To meet full 150 QPS/p95 120ms at go-live we'll need capacity increase and possibly kernel tuning; plan a perf run in staging. Please include latency traces and token-level cost breakdown in the pilot.

sara_sales: :thumbsup: I'll get the artifact + contract confirmation and schedule a sync with Acme for next Wed. Adding INF-4321 to customer's intake.
